mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 3% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth above 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window with FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to increased wage pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected monetary policy responses.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening supply chains, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this interaction remains below 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window during easing cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but this effect is mitigated if RSAFS (retail sales) growth is below 2% YoY.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 40% of months with HOUST above 1200K and RSAFS YoY growth below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 25bps in a single month signals an aggressive monetary policy easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this trigger remains below 0.04 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200K signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but this effect is enhanced if UNRATE is below 5%.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with PAYEMS above 200K and UNRATE below 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A YoY increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 4% signals robust consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, regardless of the monetary policy stance.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this proxy remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window with RSAFS YoY growth above 4%.
